kicker: Endometrial Cancer · Gynecol Oncol 2026 · Prospective Cohort
kicker_zh: 子宫内膜癌 · Gynecol Oncol 2026 · 前瞻队列
title: CDO1/CELF4 Methylation as the Dominant Predictor of Endometrial Cancer
title_zh: CDO1/CELF4 甲基化是子宫内膜癌的主导预测因子
subtitle: 573 hysteroscopy-referred women — CISENDO® strongest independent predictor: adjusted OR 103.9 (pre-) / 118.0 (post-menopausal)
subtitle_zh: 573 例宫腔镜转诊女性——CISENDO® 最强独立预测因子：绝经前调整 OR 103.9 / 绝经后 118.0
authors: Wang X, Zheng L, Zhu G, Wang S, Li W, Liu J, Gao H, Liu X, Li G, Li L, Hong L
authors_zh: 王秀珍, 郑琅, 朱根海, 王圣坦, 李伟, 刘军, 高浩成, 刘晓航, 李桂飞, 李雷, 洪澜

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: endometrial cancer (EC) screening relies on symptoms and TVS thickness — both imprecise, especially in premenopausal women with normal endometrium.
Question: is cervical CDO1/CELF4 methylation the dominant predictor of EC across menopausal status?
Why it matters: a non-invasive dominant predictor could change who gets hysteroscopy.
bullets_zh: 空白：子宫内膜癌（EC）筛查依赖症状与 TVS 内膜厚度——均不精确，尤其绝经前内膜正常者。
问题：宫颈 CDO1/CELF4 甲基化是否是跨绝经状态 EC 的主导预测因子？
意义：无创主导预测因子可改变谁该做宫腔镜。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: prospective cross-sectional cohort (Jan–Jun 2022); Hainan Provincial People's Hospital.
Population: 573 women (41 EC / 8 EIN / 524 non-EC); 462 premenopausal (29 EC) + 111 postmenopausal (12 EC).
Methylation: cervical scrape CISENDO® (NMPA Class III 20243402610); positive = ΔCtCDO1 ≤ 8.4 or ΔCtCELF4 ≤ 8.8.
Analysis: multivariate logistic stratified by menopausal status; combined with TVS thickness.
bullets_zh: 设计：前瞻性横断面队列（2022.1–6）；海南省人民医院。
人群：573 例（EC 41 / EIN 8 / 非 EC 524）；绝经前 462（EC 29）+ 绝经后 111（EC 12）。
甲基化：宫颈刮片 CISENDO®（NMPA Ⅲ类 20243402610）；阳性 = ΔCtCDO1 ≤ 8.4 或 ΔCtCELF4 ≤ 8.8。
分析：按绝经状态分层多因素 Logistic；联合 TVS 内膜厚度。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: Accuracy: premenopausal sens 89.7% / spec 93.0% / AUC 0.91; postmenopausal 91.7% / 91.8% / AUC 0.92.
Dominant predictor: CISENDO only independent factor — adjusted OR 103.9 (pre) / 118.0 (post); AUB, age, ET lost significance.
Hidden cancers: 55.2% of premenopausal EC had ET < 11 mm but were CISENDO+.
Reduced workup: 53.1% of postmenopausal non-EC with ET ≥ 5 mm were CISENDO− → fewer invasive checks.
bullets_zh: 准确性：绝经前 灵敏度 89.7% / 特异度 93.0% / AUC 0.91；绝经后 91.7% / 91.8% / AUC 0.92。
主导预测因子：CISENDO 唯一独立因素——调整 OR 103.9（绝经前）/ 118.0（绝经后）；AUB、年龄、ET 均失去独立意义。
隐匿癌：55.2% 绝经前 EC 的 ET < 11 mm 但 CISENDO 阳性。
减少检查：53.1% ET ≥ 5 mm 的绝经后非 EC 为 CISENDO 阴性→更少侵入性检查。

panels.title: Clinical value
bullets: Beyond ultrasound: methylation outperforms ET and clinical parameters in both menopausal groups.
Triage fit: CISENDO + ET (OR rule) → sens 96.6% (pre) / 100% (post) — a powerful referral gate.
Early cancer value: catches EC with normal endometrial thickness — the current screening blind spot.
bullets_zh: 超越超声：甲基化在两个绝经组均优于 ET 与临床参数。
分流适配：CISENDO + ET（OR 规则）→ 灵敏度 96.6%（绝经前）/ 100%（绝经后）——强效转诊闸门。
早期癌价值：捕获内膜厚度正常的 EC——当前筛查的盲区。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Methylation dominates: CISENDO is THE dominant EC predictor (OR 104–118) across menopausal status.
Fills the blind spot: detects EC with normal ET — a non-invasive triage that out-predicts ultrasound.
bullets_zh: 甲基化主导：CISENDO 是跨绝经状态 EC 的主导预测因子（OR 104–118）。
填补盲区：检出内膜厚度正常的 EC——超越超声的无创分流。

kicker_zh: 子宫内膜癌 · Diagnostics 2026;16:174 · 前瞻验证
title: Clinical Validation of Cervical DNA Methylation for Endometrial Cancer
title_zh: 宫颈细胞 DNA 甲基化检测子宫内膜癌的临床验证
subtitle: 2,164 suspected-lesion women — sensitivity 93.94% / specificity 96.7% (NPV 99.90%); +TVS reaches 100% sens
subtitle_zh: 2,164 例可疑病变女性——灵敏度 93.94% / 特异度 96.7%（NPV 99.90%）；+TVS 达 100% 灵敏度
authors: Yu Y, Su T, Zhang H, Li Q, Cong Q, Sui L, Chen L
authors_zh: 于怡, 苏婷婷, 张宏伟, 李青, 丛青, 隋龙, 陈丽梅

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: women with suspected endometrial lesions need a non-invasive pre-hysteroscopy triage to avoid unnecessary surgery.
Question: how accurately does cervical CDO1/CELF4 methylation detect EC/EIN in a large suspected-lesion cohort?
Why it matters: a validated triage could spare thousands of negative hysteroscopies.
bullets_zh: 空白：可疑内膜病变女性在宫腔镜前需要无创分流以避免不必要手术。
问题：宫颈 CDO1/CELF4 甲基化在大样本可疑病变队列中检测 EC/EIN 的准确性如何？
意义：经验证的分流可省去数千例阴性宫腔镜。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: prospective single-center validation (Jul 2023–May 2024); Obstetrics & Gynecology Hospital of Fudan University.
Population: 2,164 pre-hysteroscopy women (33 EC / 31 EIN / 2,100 non-endometrial); 1,324 pre- + 840 postmenopausal.
Methylation: BD cytology brush CDO1/CELF4 kit; Youden-optimized ΔCt cut-offs.
Reference: hysteroscopic histopathology; TVS ET thresholds 11 mm (pre) / 5 mm (post).
bullets_zh: 设计：前瞻性单中心验证（2023.7–2024.5）；复旦大学附属妇产科医院。
人群：宫腔镜前 2,164 例（EC 33 / EIN 31 / 非内膜病变 2,100）；绝经前 1,324 + 绝经后 840。
甲基化：BD 液基刷 CDO1/CELF4 试剂盒；Youden 优化 ΔCt 界值。
金标准：宫腔镜组织病理；TVS 阈值 11 mm（绝经前）/ 5 mm（绝经后）。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: EC detection: sensitivity 93.94% · specificity 96.7% · PPV 31.0% · NPV 99.90%.
EIN detection: sensitivity 83.87% · specificity 97.95% · NPV 99.76%.
+TVS combo: sensitivity and NPV both 100% (EC) — methylation + TVS is a perfect safety net.
Early stage: 92.9% of stage-I EC positive; 100% of type-II EC detected.
bullets_zh: EC 检出：灵敏度 93.94% · 特异度 96.7% · PPV 31.0% · NPV 99.90%。
EIN 检出：灵敏度 83.87% · 特异度 97.95% · NPV 99.76%。
+TVS 联合：灵敏度与 NPV 均达 100%（EC）——甲基化 + TVS 是完美安全网。
早期癌：I 期 EC 92.9% 阳性；II 型 EC 100% 检出。

panels.title: Validation
bullets: Sanger concordance: 205-sample re-check — CDO1/CELF4 100% agreement, Kappa 0.9900/0.9885.
Menopausal: premenopausal sens 92.3% / postmenopausal 95.0%.
Conclusion: a simple, non-invasive triage for suspected endometrial lesions — validated at scale.
bullets_zh: Sanger 一致性：205 例复核——CDO1/CELF4 符合率 100%，Kappa 0.9900/0.9885。
绝经分层：绝经前灵敏度 92.3% / 绝经后 95.0%。
结论：可疑内膜病变的简单无创分流——大规模验证。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Validated at scale: 93.94% sens / 96.7% spec in 2,164 women — with NPV 99.90%.
Perfect safety net with TVS: 100% sensitivity — a powerful pre-hysteroscopy triage.
bullets_zh: 大规模验证：2,164 例中灵敏度 93.94% / 特异度 96.7%——NPV 99.90%。
+TVS 完美安全网：100% 灵敏度——强效的宫腔镜前分流。

kicker: Endometrial Cancer · Front Oncol 2026;16:1849730 · EndoMethy-I Trial
kicker_zh: 子宫内膜癌 · Front Oncol 2026;16:1849730 · EndoMethy-I 试验
title: Hypermethylated Gene Markers in Cervical Samples for EC Detection (EndoMethy-I)
title_zh: 宫颈样本高甲基化基因标志物检测子宫内膜癌（EndoMethy-I 试验）
subtitle: 496-woman trial — CDO1/CELF4/NEFM panel: sensitivity 94.6% / specificity 92.8% in validation
subtitle_zh: 496 例试验——CDO1/CELF4/NEFM 组合：验证集灵敏度 94.6% / 特异度 92.8%
authors: Chen X, Liu L, Jin X, Cheng Y, Wu H, You Y, Liou Y, Liu P, Lang J, Li L
authors_zh: 陈小静, 刘丽欣, 金西桐, 程亚楠, 吴焕文, 尤燕, 刘雨丽, 刘沛, 郎景和, 李雷

panels.title: Trial design
bullets: Question: can a hypermethylated-gene panel in cervical scrapes detect EC better than CA125/BMI/TVS?
Design: three-stage — EPIC-array discovery (40 paired samples) → training (347) → validation (149); single-center prospective (NCT04651738).
Method: qMSP for CDO1/CELF4/NEFM; decision tree with bleeding + TVS.
bullets_zh: 问题：宫颈刮片高甲基化基因组合能否比 CA125/BMI/TVS 更好地检出 EC？
设计：三阶段——EPIC 芯片探索（40 例配对）→ 训练（347）→ 验证（149）；单中心前瞻（NCT04651738）。
方法：qMSP 检测 CDO1/CELF4/NEFM；含出血症状与 TVS 的决策树。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: Validation panel (CDO1/CELF4/NEFM): sensitivity 94.6% · specificity 92.8% — any-positive rule.
Single genes (training): CDO1 AUC 0.93 · NEFM 0.91 · CELF4 0.89; triple panel AUC 92.69%.
vs clinical: methylation far above CA125 (sens 53.85%) and TVS (55.13%).
Decision tree: methylation + TVS missed only 2 cancers (young Lynch women); hysteroscopy rate 25.0%.
bullets_zh: 验证组合（CDO1/CELF4/NEFM）：灵敏度 94.6% · 特异度 92.8%——任一阳性规则。
单基因（训练）：CDO1 AUC 0.93 · NEFM 0.91 · CELF4 0.89；三基因组合 AUC 92.69%。
vs 临床指标：甲基化远优于 CA125（灵敏度 53.85%）与 TVS（55.13%）。
决策树：甲基化 + TVS 仅漏诊 2 例癌（年轻 Lynch 女性）；宫腔镜率 25.0%。

panels.title: Clinical value
bullets: Reliable non-invasive strategy: outperforms every other non-invasive EC assessment.
Lynch caution: young Lynch women may need direct hysteroscopy despite negative methylation.
Fit: supports methylation as a screening/triage tool before invasive sampling.
bullets_zh: 可靠无创策略：优于所有其他无创 EC 评估。
Lynch 警示：年轻 Lynch 女性即使甲基化阴性也可能需直接宫腔镜。
适配：支持甲基化作为侵入性取样前的筛查/分流工具。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Panel wins: CDO1/CELF4/NEFM reaches 94.6% sens / 92.8% spec — the best non-invasive EC strategy.
System fit: methylation + TVS decision tree minimizes both missed cancers and hysteroscopies.
bullets_zh: 组合胜出：CDO1/CELF4/NEFM 达 94.6% 灵敏度 / 92.8% 特异度——最佳无创 EC 策略。
系统适配：甲基化 + TVS 决策树同时最小化漏诊癌与宫腔镜数量。
